title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Verndale is a digital experience agency dedicated to driving growth by helping businesses create meaningful human connections in an increasingly digital world. With offices in Boston, Montreal, Los Angeles, Quito, and hubs across the Americas, we partner with marketing and technology leaders to deliver personalized web, mobile, and ecommerce solutions that elevate customer experiences.
At Verndale, we thrive on collaboration and innovation, offering a full range of services that span strategy, design, development, personalization, SEO, analytics, and digital advertising. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, striving to create a climate of respect essential for both individual and company success.
If you're ready to be part of a passionate team dedicated to making an impact and driving growth, we invite you to explore a career at Verndale.
About The Role
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager with a passion for working hand-in-hand with our clients to deliver world-class interactive experiences. Our work includes experience design, digital marketing campaigns, eCommerce and CMS implementations, CRM programs and content development. As a Senior Project Manager, you will help develop and execute the plans that allow our teams to create great work and deliver tremendous value. To succeed in this role, you will need to be a natural leader, an advocate for your team and your clients, have a passion for technology and possess strong project management and communication skills.
Responsibilities
Solve problems. Recognize the nature of each problem and ensure the right people are involved to help solve it. Be an active contributor to that solution, not just a communication facilitator.
Manage ongoing work, budgets, and schedules for a portfolio of client accounts.
Maintain an understanding of Verndale's capabilities and be able to match those capabilities up with client needs. Recognize gaps in capabilities and work with management to devise solutions to fill those gaps.
Work with clients and internal teams to ensure that all work is in line with clients' short- and long-term strategic goals.
Deliver regular status reports to clients
Coordinate internal teams to ensure the right people are on the right projects at the right time.
Mentor other Project Coordinators and Project Managers.
Define and enhance project and business processes, ensure teams are following appropriate processes. Know why process is important but don't be afraid to deviate from it when the situation warrants it. Draw on your agency background and creativity to suggest and implement process enhancements.
Facilitate communication and alignment between Verndale's team, client teams, and third parties as needed. Break down barriers that impede progress.
Create, manage, and communicate project/initiative schedules to all involved parties and stakeholders
Assist account team with knowledge of clients and project needs to aid revenue growth within the account
Keep up to date on a broad spectrum of technologies, recognizing when new technologies or updates offer new opportunities for clients.
Qualifications
5–7+ years managing digital/technology projects in an agency or consulting environment.
Proven experience leading full lifecycle web or platform implementations (e.g., Sitecore, Content stack, Webflow, Optimizely).
Strong project financial management: forecasting, burn tracking, managing to budget, and driving profitable delivery.
Demonstrated success with scope, risk, and change management in complex, multi-stakeholder engagements.
Excellent client-facing communication and expectation management (written and verbal).
Strong cross-functional collaboration with strategy, UX, engineering, QA, and DevOps teams.
Experience managing multi-vendor or offshore/nearshore teams.
Solid command of Jira and common PM tools (Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet, etc.).
Comfortable working in hybrid Agile / waterfall delivery model
Nice to Have
Background with digital commerce, customer portals, or large content-driven sites.
Familiarity with GA4, GTM, and analytics-driven optimization initiatives.
Formal PM credentials (e.g., PMP, CSM, SAFe, or equivalent).
Experience in statement of work (SOW) creation and upsell/expansion discussions with clients.
Ten Great Reasons to Work at Verndale
We are a rapidly growing company that is just as scrappy and entrepreneurial today as when we were founded in 1998.
We are relentlessly curious and enthusiastically solve our clients' complex business problems through technology, data, and design.

title: Organizational Design
description:
This position requires full relocation to Saudi Arabia. It is a permanent full time Expat relocation package.
Job Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced Org & Mgmt Specialist to join the Organizational Consulting Department (OCD) within the HR & Corporate Services organization.
The OCD department plays a key role in strategy execution, operating model design, organization effectiveness, transformation advisory, corporate governance, and complex program delivery.
As a trusted advisor to senior leaders, you will shape enterprise-wide Operating Model Transformation solutions, drive alignment across business lines, and enable the successful execution of strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Lead high-impact operating model and organization design engagements across diverse business entities.
Assess current-state organizational structures and design future-state spans of control, governance, workflows, and decision rights.
Develop standardized frameworks, methodologies, and toolkits for operating model and organization design projects.
Provide executive-level advisory services on strategy, transformation, and organizational effectiveness.
Prepare and deliver presentations, briefing notes, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
Design and facilitate workshops to drive alignment and support decision-making at executive levels.
Develop and implement corporate governance frameworks balancing standardization with business flexibility.
Drive group-wide operating model alignment including affiliates, joint ventures, and international operations.
Oversee post-merger integration (PMI) activities, ensuring operational and cultural alignment of acquired entities.
Develop, refine, and deploy enterprise playbooks, operating principles, and organizational guidelines.
Conduct benchmarking, market studies, and research to inform structural, strategic, and operational decisions.
Provide strategic counsel to leaders navigating organizational change, growth, risk mitigation, or restructuring.
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, Engineering, or related discipline; Master's degree preferred.
Minimum 12 years of experience in management consulting, with deep expertise in operating models, organization design, PMI, governance, or transformation.
Proven ability to manage large-scale consulting initiatives within complex, multinational organizations.
Strong command of organization design and process improvement methodologies and tools.
Exceptional communication, persuasion, and stakeholder engagement skills, including executive presence.
High proficiency in analytical thinking, problem-solving, and applying structured approaches to complex challenges.
Experience operating in fast-paced environments with high ambiguity.
Ability to influence senior leadership and drive alignment across cross-functional and global teams.
Working environment
Our high-performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly.
At Aramco, our people work on truly world-scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. And because, as a global energy company, we are faced with addressing some of the world's biggest technical, logistical and environmental challenges, we invest heavily in talent development.
We have a proud history of educating and training our workforce over many decades. Employees at all levels are encouraged to improve their sector-specific knowledge and competencies through our workforce development programs – one of the largest in the world.
Aramco energizes the world economy.
Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world's largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.
With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco's value to society.
Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations' spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom's vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.
We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

title: Creative Strategist
description:
Buy Box Experts (BBE) is a Spreetail Agency, our mission at BBE is to be premier Amazon strategists by successfully evolving and adapting to the ever-changing environment that is Amazon and e-commerce. Our strategic growth mindset and holistic approach encourage forward-thinking and provide the greatest potential for success for our Brand Partners.

We're looking for a Creative Strategist with 2-3 years of experience in e-commerce marketing and creative strategy to develop compelling brand narratives, drive conversion-focused projects, and collaborate with cross-functional teams. The ideal candidate has strong writing and communication skills, can distill complex information into clear messaging, and understands design principles and industry trends.

How you will achieve success:

    • Develop strategic narratives, experience design, and technical storytelling to shape brand messaging.
  • Research, conceptualize, and execute creative ideas that align with client and industry visions.
  • Translate audience insights into actionable strategies, marketing initiatives, and engagement tactics.

  • Strong project management, writing, and communication skills.
  • Ability to distill complex information and conduct qualitative analysis.
  • Experience with design principles, cross-functional collaboration, and third-party partnerships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and Google Suite.
  • Preferred: Experience with Amazon Seller/Vendor Central and Adobe Creative Suite.

We considers candidates who meet the specific job qualifications, whether they are located near our Lehi, UT office or have the ability to work remotely.

Please visit to learn more about us.

ABOUT BUY BOX EXPERTS

Buy Box Experts, a Spreetail Agency, is a premier Amazon marketing agency, supporting brand executives as they seek to CONTROL and GROW their Amazon channel businesses (in the US and internationally).

We help our brand clients develop channel management strategies that reduce price erosion issues, and align marketing efforts with the brand's overall brand vision. We provide full platform account management (1P retail, 3P marketplace and hybrid) incorporating inventory management, listing optimization, advertising campaign management (including AMS, DSP), and customer service. We also operate traffic-building campaigns external to Amazon, designed to drive high-converting traffic to Amazon. We conduct Amazon channel due diligence for private equity and investors looking to acquire brands that depend heavily on Amazon as a sales channel.

Our leadership team is very focused on building a company culture focused on being inclusive, encouraging open discussion of issues, and developing the team through a growth-based mindset. title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Enterprise Architect. Rio de Janeiro. Posting Date: 01/16/2026. Deadline: 01/29/2026
Role Title: Enterprise Architect
Contract Type: Regular
Reporting To: Deputy CIO
Program/Department/Unit Name: Information Technology
Location: Rio & Mexico City
Team Name: IT Governance
Role Purpose
The Enterprise Architect role is responsible for designing and managing the overall architecture of an organization's IT systems and infrastructure. This role involves aligning IT strategy with business goals, creating architectural frameworks, and ensuring that technology solutions are scalable, secure, and efficient. The Enterprise Architect collaborates with various internal and external stakeholders to identify technology needs and guide the implementation of IT initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
As the Enterprise Architect, your key responsibilities are as follows:
Establish EA governance, EA frameworks, EA methodology and create EA artifacts, EA standards and best practices.
Design and promote architectural standards, guidelines, and best practices across the organization.
Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements and translate them into architectural solutions.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to inform architectural decisions and recommendation
Facilitate architecture review boards and governance processes to ensure compliance with architectural standards.
Provide guidance and support to project teams in implementing architectural solutions.
Instruct, manage, and mentor development teams
Communicate enterprise architecture with other department managers within the organization, outsourcing providers and report on continuous improvement initiatives.
Oversee Change Control board, participate in Project Review Board to ensure adherence to architectural standards.
People Responsibilities (Total Team/DRs)
No
Key metrics
EA KPIs such as strategic alignment, business process optimization, innovation enablement, efficiency, architecture compliance and risk management
Key internal relationships
CIO, Deputy CIO, Functional leads, Operations leads, GDPR team, Legal, Finance, Global Security, IT Security, Technology Services, System/Application Owners, Program/Opportunity leads.
Key external relationships
IT vendors in various markets, external consulting experts, EA colleagues at non-profit institutions with similar IT landscape, large global software providers, etc.
The ideal candidate
Essential
Bachelor's degree in computer science, IT, or a related field
Master's degree in IT management, business management, or enterprise architecture
Certifications such TOGAF, CISSP (for cybersecurity focus), and cloud-specific certifications from providers like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud are beneficial
10 years of relevant experience in Enterprise Architecture, with a background in software engineering, network security, cloud computing, systems analysis, data management or other related fields.
Strong understanding of business needs, technology trends, and architectural frameworks.
Experience creating and maintaining comprehensive Enterprise Architecture frameworks.
Experience with architecture modelling tools CAD, BIM, and 3D modelling software.
Strong understanding of IT enterprise systems and platforms (Salesforce, NetSuite, Workday) and architectures
Deep knowledge of various technologies, including cloud computing, data management, networking, and security.
Ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Ability to analyse complex business problems and develop innovative solutions.
Ability to lead and mentor development teams and influence stakeholders.
Experience with architectural frameworks and methodologies TOGAF or Zachman, and agile methodologies.
Experience with cloud computing, network security, data management, and application integration.
High level understanding and interest of geo-political implications of Open Society's work.
Travel is required. Travel frequency depends on the role requirements.
Languages
An excellent knowledge of English
What We Offer
Exceptional opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact; from a generous annual professional development allowance for every employee to onsite training and learning conversations with visiting experts.
Excellent benefits and perks to promote well-being and a healthy work-life balance, including:
Generous time off and flexible work arrangements.
Employer-paid health insurance and dental plans for individuals and families (no employee contribution required).
Exceptional retirement savings plan (non-contributory for employees) and life insurance.
Progressive paid parental leave, reproductive and family planning support, and much more.
A commitment to nurturing a diverse and inclusive workplace, so you can bring your whole self to work and make a positive impact.
The salary range for this role in the US is $ 145,666 - $ 161,851 (USD). The final offer is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set and level of experience
Who We Are
Open Society Foundations aim to establish vibrant and inclusive democracies where governments are accountable to their citizens. Our operating model organizes grantmaking around specific, time-limited projects, developed alongside support for established partners, enabling us to respond swiftly to emerging needs. We are committed to promoting human dignity, equality, and rights; reimagining democratic ideals and practice; and advancing equity in governance systems.
Guided by our founder's values and the belief in the art of the possible, we engage directly with global entities, individuals, and policymakers through grants, advocacy, impact investing, and strategic human rights litigation to drive positive change. At the heart of our mission is a deep commitment to rights, equity, and justice, inspiring every action we take.
Additional Information
Open Society Foundations is committed to building an inclusive workforce that reflects the communities we serve. We actively seek applications from talented individuals across all backgrounds, identities, and life experiences. Each candidate is evaluated solely on their unique qualifications without regard to race, age, sex, religion, ethnic origin, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, or any other legally protected characteristics.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities.
Competitive rates of pay apply.

Legal se souber | experiência:

A Fênix faz parte da Arquiconsult, uma empresa consolidada com ampla experiência no mercado internacional e forte parceria com a Microsoft. Com operações em países como Brasil, Estados Unidos, Espanha, Portugal e diversos outros, a Fênix é referência em projetos Microsoft e soluções em Microsoft Business Applications. Com 26 anos de atuação, a empresa oferece soluções técnicas integradas que atendem às exigências fiscais e de governança corporativa, promovendo a transformação digital de organizações. Nosso compromisso é conectar tecnologia a decisões estratégicas, incentivando a inovação, eficiência e sustentabilidade no ambiente corporativo.

Descrição do Cargo
Estamos à procura de um Consultor Funcional ERP Júnior para atuar na nossa unidade no Rio de Janeiro, RJ. Este cargo é responsável por realizar a análise e o mapeamento de processos de negócios, levantamento de requisitos e demandas de clientes, implementação de soluções ERP baseadas em Microsoft Dynamics e suporte às rotinas operacionais. O profissional também terá interação direta com as equipes internas e clientes para garantir eficiência e alinhamento com as melhores práticas. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer atuação presencial.

Qualificações

  • Habilidades Analíticas:
    Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas para mapear e otimizar processos de negócios e atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Comunicação:
    Excelência em comunicação verbal e escrita para colaborar efetivamente com clientes e equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Processos de Negócio:
    Conhecimento em documentação, análise de processos e desenvolvimento de soluções personalizadas para diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Consultoria:
    Experiência em funções voltadas para consultoria, especialmente implementação e suporte de sistemas ERP.
  • Finanças:
    Entendimento sólido em práticas financeiras relacionadas a ERP, incluindo processos contábeis e de gestão financeira organizacional.
  • Diferenciais incluem experiência prévia com Microsoft Business Applications, certificações específicas e proficiência em inglês e/ou espanhol.

Remuneração e Benefícios

  • Salário:
    Pretensão Salarial;
  • Benefícios corporativos da Fênix (convênio médico e odontológico, seguro de vida, Gympass/Wellhub, Cartão flexível Flash, convênios educacionais, SESC, entre outros).

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Vaga: Vendedor Externo Consultivo (B2B) – RJ

Empresa:
Dallminas

Modelo de trabalho:
Remoto / Com visitas externas

Local de atuação:
Rio de Janeiro/RJ (foco em Capital, com possíveis visitas pontuais à Região dos Lagos e região industrial)

Objetivo da posição

Expansão de mercado e aumento de presença regional
no Rio de Janeiro.

O papel central desta posição é estar próximo do mercado, no lugar certo, com as pessoas certas, e construir uma base comercial sólida para crescimento consistente.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Atuar em campo com
    vendas técnicas e consultivas
    (ciclo de médio e longo prazo), com foco em presença e relacionamento
  • Visitar
    clientes certos (oportunidades)
    — a empresa não realiza visitas "para prospectar por prospecção"
  • Equilibrar a rotina entre:
  • Gestão de carteira
    (clientes ativos serão repassados para maximizar potencial)
  • Reativação
    de clientes inativos
  • Prospecção ativa
    em contas com pré-filtragem
  • Atuação com
    leads qualificados
    repassados pelo time de SDR
  • Registrar e operar o funil comercial no CRM
  • Participar de
    reuniões diárias (dailys)
    e
    checkpoint semanal (relatório)
  • Trabalhar com metas e indicadores claros (ex.:
    faturamento, margem, recorrência, volume (ton) e mix de produtos
    )
  • Acionar e se integrar ao
    time técnico
    para agendamento de visitas/calls quando necessário, garantindo especificações técnicas corretas

Produtos e perfil de cliente

Portfólio (linha de químicos para construção):
selantes (silicone, PU, acrílicos), impermeabilizantes de diversos tipos.

Perfil de clientes atendidos:
construtoras, aplicadores, empreiteiros e, em alguns casos, clientes finais/investidores do ramo imobiliário.

Perfil técnico esperado

  • Vivência em
    vendas B2B
  • Domínio de
    CRM
    (disciplina de processo e registro)
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de
    técnicas de venda,
    e condução de jornada longa

Formação desejável:
Engenharia, Arquitetura ou Administração

Diferencial:
conhecimento de
canteiro de obras
(como funciona uma obra, quem são as pessoas e como se dá a decisão).

Perfil comportamental

Buscamos uma pessoa:

  • Com
    mentalidade consultiva genuína
    , escuta ativa e leitura de cenário
  • Com disciplina comercial e respeito ao processo
  • Não imediatista
    (entende que o "sim" leva tempo e que o começo tende a ser mais lento)
  • Perfil híbrido com predominância clara:
    autônomo + resiliente + relacional
    , com
    execução disciplinada

Não se adapta a esta vaga quem:

  • É imediatista e obcecado por fechamento rápido
  • Atua como "vendedor de produto" (e não de solução)
  • Empurra solução inadequada (falta de ética técnica)

Indicadores de sucesso (3 a 6 meses)

  • Absorver cultura e construir autonomia real na rotina
  • Qualidade e consistência do uso do CRM
  • Integração com time técnico
  • Evolução no aprendizado técnico (início de especificações técnicas)
  • Primeiros fechamentos realizados com consistência

Informações da vaga:

  • Regime de contratação:
    CLT
  • Remuneração fixa:
    R$3.500
  • Comissão variável:
    1 a 4% sobre as vendas
  • Carga horária:
    44h semanais
  • Benefícios:
    carro, combustível e vale-alimentação.

title: Estagiário de FP&A
description:

Entendemos que desempenhamos um papel crucial no mundo dos negócios, pois ajudamos empresas a gerenciar e mitigar riscos que possam afetar suas operações, finanças e reputação, além de proteger seus ativos.

Através da nossa atuação e das soluções que oferecemos, permitimos que as empresas se concentrem em seus objetivos comerciais, sabendo que estão preparadas para enfrentar desafios inesperados.

Nosso jeito Austral de ser envolve dinamismo, experiência com flexibilidade e um time de especialistas com longa experiência no mercado ressegurador e segurador e sólida reputação na geração de resultados, prontos para lidar com o mercado brasileiro e compreender as necessidades específicas de cada negócio.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco, movidos pelo propósito de ampliar a sensação de segurança das pessoas com quem nos relacionamos, simplificando interações e criando, lado a lado, as melhores soluções.

Cursando ensino superior nas áreas:
Economia, Administração, Contabilidade, Engenharia de Produção.

Conhecimentos:
Bom conhecimento em Excel, Programação e Power BI.

Atividades:

Apurar e apoiar relatórios sobre os resultados gerenciais mensais das companhias do grupo com abertura por segmento de negócios. Analisar o relatório de despesas para acompanhamento mensal do processo de execução orçamentária; Apoiar na elaboração do orçamento anual de resultado (receitas e despesas) das companhias do grupo; Apoiar na atualização das informações gerenciais a serem apresentadas à alta administração e ao Conselho de Administração; Atualizar Best Guess de resultado para as companhias do grupo; Desenvolver e gerar relatórios para acompanhamento da operação da companhia; Analisar as atividades sob sua responsabilidade, propondo alterações e atualizações nos processos realizados e ferramentas, a fim de cumprir metas e objetivos estabelecidos.

title: Gerente de Turno
description:
DESCRIPTION


A equipe da Amazon Logística está em busca de um(a) Gerente de Turno da Noite para se juntar à equipe da AMZL Brasil em nossa Delivery Station de Rio de Janeiro-RJ.
Como Gerente de Turno, você será responsável pela operação noturna em uma Estação de Entrega, fornecendo liderança para Líderes de Equipe, Operadores e Prestadores de Serviços de Entrega, gerenciando relacionamentos e desempenho de agências externas. Você trabalhará em um ambiente altamente colaborativo que é mais semelhante a uma start-up do que a uma grande empresa. A atitude adotada é que nenhuma ideia é uma má ideia e as melhores ideias são aquelas que devem ser testadas e experimentadas. Você precisará prosperar e entregar resultados em um ambiente ambíguo, rápido e dinâmico. Se você tem um histórico focado na qualidade e obcecado pelo cliente, que carrega consigo a experiência de trabalhar em um ambiente dinâmico, em constante mudança e ambíguo, adoraríamos ouvir sua opinião. A função envolve:

  • Estar baseado em um de nossos postos de entrega, no turno da noite. A Amazon opera 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, portanto, o trabalho em turnos fará parte dessa função, incluindo finais de semana e feriados.
  • Supervisão da operação que foca na entrega de pedidos da Amazon direto aos clientes
  • Apoiar sua equipe de líderes operacionais na gestão diária do posto de entrega. Isso incluirá alocação de mão de obra, liderança de reuniões, atribuição de tarefas e comunicação com fornecedores internos e externos.
  • Trabalhar com KPIs como On Time Dispatch, First Day Delivery Success e melhorar o atendimento ao cliente.
  • Pensar analiticamente sobre gerenciamento de projetos com atenção aos detalhes, capacidade de influenciar os outros e habilidades organizacionais excepcionais.
  • Ser obcecado por métricas e mergulhar fundo para encontrar as causas raízes rapidamente para gerar melhorias.
  • Encontrar soluções práticas e simples para problemas complexos sem sacrificar a qualidade ou a funcionalidade principal. Utilizando habilidades excepcionais de resolução de problemas e comunicação para influenciar o público comercial e técnico.
  • Fornecer suporte diário durante a implantação/implementação de novos sistemas/processos e coletar feedback.
  • Mapeamento de requisitos de negócios, entendimento de processos de negócios, estudo e análise de fluxos de trabalho e desenho de soluções.
  • Utilizar continuamente ferramentas de software e hardware para garantir operações normais do dia a dia. Garantir que os associados tenham as ferramentas adequadas para realizar o trabalho e coordenar o reparo ou substituição quando necessário.
  • Comunicar métricas diárias e relatar exceções a outros departamentos de Operações e em toda a Amazon, conforme necessário.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • equivalent, or High school diploma
  • Experience within a manufacturing or production environment
  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques
  • Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or experience in Engineering, Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
  • Experience working with changing priorities and schedules
  • Experience delivering results for large, cross-functional initiatives/projects, or experience in multiple finance and accounting roles

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

SOBRE A PANDORA
A Joalheria que Transforma Histórias em Joias
Com sede em Copenhague, Dinamarca, a Pandora fabrica suas deslumbrantes joias em três instalações de artesanato na Tailândia, onde mestres artesãos dedicam-se a criar cada peça com perfeição, se destacando como a maior joalheria do mundo, famosa por seus icônicos braceletes e charms que permitem que você conte sua própria história. Além disso, suas coleções incluem anéis, brincos e colares, todos com designs exclusivos e elaborados à mão, utilizando apenas materiais de altíssima qualidade.

A Pandora é pioneira no setor, sendo a primeira joalheria do mundo a utilizar produtos 100% reciclados. Com um compromisso firme com a sustentabilidade, cada peça não é apenas uma joia, mas uma celebração do estilo e da consciência ambiental.

We Dream (Sonhamos), somos visionários e vamos além do óbvio. We Dare (Ousamos) perseguir ambições ousadas com coragem e rapidez. We Care (Cuidamos) nós nos preocupamos profundamente uns com os outros, com nossos clientes e com o planeta que todos compartilhamos. Todos os dias nos esforçamos para ser um local de trabalho gratificante, onde cada um de nós pode prosperar e contribuir, onde os talentos podem crescer e cumprimos nossas promessas a colegas, clientes, parceiros e partes interessadas - We Deliver (entregamos).
Somos todos embaixadores de nossa marca e, juntos, formamos a comunidade Pandora.

• Atendimento ao cliente na pós-venda;

• Gestão e organização de estoque, operação do sistema, devoluções e trocas;

• Manter a organização, montagem e limpeza da vitrine;
• Participar dos treinamentos internos, sobre os produtos de luxo feito à mão para se tornar um especialista em produtos PANDORA;
• Seguir as diretrizes da empresa, cumprindo todas as políticas e procedimentos, a fim de manter o padrão internacional de nossas lojas;

• Ensino médio completo;
• Experiência em atendimento ao cliente e em vendas;
• Comunicação clara e receptiva, capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes com constantes mudanças;

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.

As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.

You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.

*Note: this is a remote position for candidate who is based in Brazil but outside Rio.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.

  • Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.

  • Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.

  • Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.

  • Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.

  • Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.

  • Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.

  • Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels

  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs

  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

  • Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)

  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale

  • Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights

  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

  • Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

  • Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses

  • Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

  • Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Se você quer fazer parte desse desafio, essa oportunidade é a sua chance. Nessa posição de Senior Manager of Data & AI , você irá somar ao Time Data & AI , que tem como objetivo transformar e exponenciar o uso de dados e inteligência artificial.

No dia a dia você vai:

  • Liderar o time de plataforma de dados, plataforma de machine learning e plataforma de AI;
  • Desenvolver uma plataforma de dados, ciência de dados e machine learning;
  • Estruturar a organização do consumo de dados que seja integrado em toda a organização;
  • Adaptar uma plataforma de inteligência artificial para garantir o consumo nos diferentes use cases;
  • Interagir com toda liderança sênior do grupo para identificar oportunidades de atuação em conjunto, dentro e fora da tecnologia.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Conhecer técnicas de inteligência artificial avançadas;
  • Vivência em toda a jornada de ciência de dados;
  • Técnicas de machine learning (ex.: regressão, regressão múltipla, classificação, clustering, etc);
  • Experiência com plataformas cloud, com ênfase em AWS;
  • Conhecimento técnico em LLMs;
  • Sólidas habilidades e vivência para exponenciar o uso de inteligência artificial entre diferentes use cases gen ai e modelagens preditivas;
  • Conhecer de forma profunda arquitetura e implementação de plataformas;
  • Inglês avançado / fluente.

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

description:

Join to apply for the Global Head of Cloud Alliances role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We are hiring a Head of Cloud Alliances to lead business development and partnerships with the global public clouds. As the publisher of Ubuntu, Canonical is already a trusted partner with the leading guest OS and select services for the major hyperscalers. We have a large portfolio of open source software on the cloud marketplace for enterprise customers, and are looking to expand our global cloud partnerships.
Reporting to the VP of Global Alliances, the Global Head of Cloud Alliances will lead teams that bring innovation to the public cloud platforms, joint go-to-market with public cloud sales communities and marketplaces, and our global customer and partner contracts. They will work closely with cloud partners, from engineering to product management and marketing, to deliver open source solutions at scale for their cloud customers.
Our Cloud Alliance team builds trusted relationships with partners at all levels, from joint technical work to executive strategy. Their goal is to increase Canonical market share in the cloud ISV ecosystem, develop cloud channel sales, evangelize the partnership and lead all business interactions. The Global Head of Cloud Alliances will own the strategy, sell-to, sell-through and sell-with motions with all cloud partners, as well as promotion of our cloud related activities - from campaigns, to strategic opportunities and cloud related events.
Our company is largely distributed, this role can be based anywhere in the Americas or EMEA.
The role entails

  • Taking ownership of Canonical's global cloud partner strategy, leading efforts to forecast, driving bookings, and growing revenue worldwide
  • Building strong, cross-functional relationships across teams to ensure a unified approach to technology and market execution
  • Inspiring and guiding teams to achieve accelerated revenue growth with Cloud partners, continually refining and evolving strategies for success
  • Establishing and nurturing executive-level relationships with key partners, laying the foundation for long-term success and mutual growth
  • Steering our offering from concept to execution, aligning product management and marketing strategies while scaling success through our global sales organization
What we are looking for in you:
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to achieve outstanding results
  • Leadership and commitment to skills development and mentorship
  • Passion for technology evidenced by personal projects and initiatives
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Exceptional leadership and presentation skills, capable of energizing teams and stakeholders while delivering compelling data-driven narratives
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite, and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organization
  • Thoughtfulness and self-motivation
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long
  • An in-depth understanding of open source technologies, Ubuntu, and the competitive ecosystem, with an eye for identifying opportunities that others might miss.
  • Autonomous, disciplined, and proactive—take ownership, and deliver exceptional results
Nice to have
  • A track record in alliance and indirect sales management, with an ability to build partnerships that drive success
  • Solid experience in the Public Cloud sector, coupled with an understanding of the evolving landscape of technology and innovation.
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

What we are looking for in you

  • Excellent communication skills in the English language, both verbal and written
  • Experience with Linux, with a preference towards Ubuntu
  • Experience with Open Source and Open Source Business Models
  • People management experience in a support organisation is a strong plus
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. description:
Overview

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Job Purpose

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will participate in the Neurodegeneration Computational Fellows Training Program (NDCF) at Howard University, developing and applying computational skills in neuroscience research. Under the mentorship of host labs, the fellow will contribute to analyzing datasets related to neurodegenerative diseases, such as Alzheimer’s, Parkinson’s, or traumatic brain injury (TBI), advancing the understanding of disease mechanisms. This role supports the program’s mission to train researchers in advanced mathematics, data analysis, and bioinformatics for neurodegeneration research.

Supervisory Authority

This position has no supervisory authority. The fellow will work directly under the supervision of a principal investigator or mentor in a host lab affiliated with the NDCF program, receiving guidance on research tasks and computational training.

Nature And Scope

The NDCF Computational Research Fellow will engage in interdisciplinary research within a host lab at Howard University or a partner institution, such as NIH/NINDS, focusing on computational approaches to neurodegeneration. The fellow will gain hands-on experience analyzing neurophysiological, genomic, or imaging data using tools like Python, R, or machine learning frameworks. The fellow will collaborate with researchers, other fellows, and faculty, participating in lab meetings and NDCF symposia. The role is designed to support professional growth by developing skills in data analysis and contributing to research publications. External opportunities may include presenting at conferences or collaborating with partners in the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network (NDCN) under the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Assist in analyzing datasets (e.g., MRI, genomic, or microbiome data) using computational tools under the guidance of a mentor, identifying patterns or biomarkers in neurodegenerative diseases.
  • Learn and apply statistical or machine learning methods to support research on disease mechanisms, following lab protocols.
  • Support data processing tasks, such as image analysis or sequence alignment, using provided software or scripts.
  • Prepare research summaries and present findings at NDCF symposia, lab meetings, or external conferences.
  • Contribute to team discussions, collaborating with lab members to integrate computational and experimental findings.
  • Maintain accurate records of research activities and adhere to ethical standards in data handling and reporting.

Core Competencies

  • Computational Aptitude: Basic familiarity with programming (e.g., Python, R) or data analysis tools, with a strong interest in learning advanced computational techniques.
  • Analytical Thinking: Ability to approach complex datasets with curiosity and apply structured methods to derive meaningful insights under mentorship.
  • Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams, including researchers, students, and faculty.
  • Communication: Clear written and verbal communication to present research progress and engage with scientific audiences.
  • Adaptability: Eagerness to acquire new skills and adapt to evolving research tools and methodologies in a training-focused environment.

Minimum Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in neuroscience, biology, computer science, bioinformatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Some exposure to programming, data analysis, or neuroscience research through coursework, internships, or personal projects. No prior expertise required.
  • Skills: Basic familiarity with computational tools (e.g., Python, R, MATLAB, or command-line interfaces) or a strong interest in learning these skills. Introductory knowledge of statistics or data visualization is a plus.
  • Other: Demonstrated interest in neurodegeneration research and the ability to work collaboratively under mentorship guidance.

Compliance Salary Range Disclosure

title: Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação
description:
Funcionários da Faetec passam a receber vale-alimentação

A Fundação de Apoio à Escola Técnica (Faetec), vinculada à Secretaria de Estado de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, iniciou nesta quinta-feira (26) a distribuição do vale-alimentação a todos os funcionários da Rede. A partir de agora, servidores de carreira e de contratos temporários podem contar com um cartão com valor mensal que pode chegar a R$660,00.
Os funcionários com carga horária de 20h semanais irão receber o valor mensal de R$330,00. Para os profissionais que trabalham 40h e 60h será depositado a quantia de R$660,00. O cartão poderá ser utilizado em estabelecimentos parceiros e já está sendo distribuído a todos os 5.162 funcionários, que atuam em mais de 120 unidades da Rede, em 63 municípios do Estado.
Além da Presidente da Faetec, Caroline Alves, o Secretário de Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação, Mauro Azevedo Neto, esteve presente na entrega do primeiro vale-alimentação a um servidor da Rede. Ele acredita que o benefício chega para reconhecer os esforços do servidor.
“Sempre que tínhamos reuniões, a Carol trazia essa pauta como valorização do servidor, então é um prazer estar aqui no momento dessa entrega. Sou filho de professora da rede estadual de educação e sei como os auxílios aos servidores e a valorização do servidor são importantes. Na secretaria já fui assistente, assessor, chefe de gabinete, subsecretário e hoje estou como secretário, então sei que são os servidores que constroem a secretaria e a Faetec. O governador está sendo um parceiro nas pautas de educação, a gente sabe que o orçamento é curto, mas sempre que valoriza o servidor, ele é bem gasto”, declarou o S ecretário.
Os servidores e temporários recebem o vale-alimentação com o benefício referente aos meses de setembro e outubro. A medida não só reconhece e valoriza os profissionais que atuam nas unidades da Faetec, mas contribui para um ambiente de trabalho mais saudável e motivador.
Para Caroline Alves, presidente da Faetec, a entrega do vale-alimentação só foi possível graças ao empenho dos próprios funcionários, que se dedicam diariamente para que a Faetec continue sendo uma instituição de excelência. A gestora aproveitou a ocasião para agradecer a parceria da Secretaria.
“Essa é uma causa dos servidores de muitos anos e é uma construção que estamos fazendo juntos, sempre tenho esse cuidado de ouvir o outro, dialogar e construir isso junto. Eu acredito que essa entrega é importante para a nossa Rede e não posso deixar de mencionar o secretário que nos ajudou, abriu caminhos e deu suporte nessa construção”, concluiu a presidente da Faetec.

description:
Join to apply for the Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica role at e.Quality Soluções e Engenharia LTDA

O Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica é o líder técnico e gestor das operações de engenharia clínica em sua unidade de atuação, assegurando a gestão segura, eficaz e economicamente responsável do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele garante a excelência na execução dos serviços, a conformidade com as regulamentações, a otimização dos recursos e o desenvolvimento da equipe técnica, atuando como um pilar fundamental para a satisfação do cliente e a qualidade do serviço.

  • Gestão Operacional e Conformidade: Assegurar a implementação e a manutenção contínua dos processos definidos no Plano de Gerenciamento de Tecnologias em Saúde (PGTS) da unidade, utilizando os sistemas e ferramentas designados. Garantir a total conformidade das operações e documentações com a legislação vigente, normas técnicas (ex: NBR IEC 60601, ISO/IEC 17025 quando aplicável) e regulamentações (ANVISA, INMETRO). Revisar e garantir a organização e controle de todos os documentos relacionados aos processos no sistema de gestão (ex: DOO), assegurando sua rastreabilidade e fácil acesso. Preparar e organizar a documentação e processos referentes à acreditação hospitalar da unidade, montando apresentações para auditorias e liderando o processo para o sucesso da certificação.
  • Liderança e Desenvolvimento de Equipe: Supervisionar e orientar diariamente as atividades dos técnicos de engenharia clínica, garantindo a qualidade e eficiência na execução dos serviços de manutenção, calibração e ensaios. Acompanhar a performance individual e da equipe, provendo feedback construtivo e participando ativamente do desenvolvimento técnico dos colaboradores. Garantir a replicação e adesão da equipe aos treinamentos ministrados pela empresa, bem como promover o compartilhamento de conhecimento técnico com a equipe e com o corpo assistencial do cliente.
  • Gestão da Manutenção e Otimização do Parque Tecnológico: Garantir a resolutividade das solicitações de manutenção corretiva, supervisionando o diagnóstico, a cotação de peças/acessórios e a proposição de soluções eficazes. Supervisionar e acompanhar a execução da manutenção planejada (preventiva e preditiva) dos equipamentos, assegurando o cumprimento dos cronogramas e a emissão dos laudos e certificados. Assegurar o correto preenchimento e registro de todas as atividades no sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), desde a abertura da solicitação até a avaliação do serviço prestado. Elaborar pareceres técnicos e laudos de obsolescência de equipamentos, baseando-se no histórico e normativas, para subsidiar a avaliação do parque tecnológico do cliente.
  • Gestão de Fornecedores e Contratos: Supervisionar os serviços realizados por terceiros e a execução de contratos dentro da unidade, por meio da análise das ordens de serviço externas. Avaliar o custo-benefício de contratos e serviços avulsos de terceiros, propondo otimizações ou alternativas. Relacionar e controlar pedidos de materiais, acessórios e peças de reposição para garantir a eficiência e a continuidade do funcionamento dos Equipamentos Médico-Hospitalares (EMH), gerenciando o estoque no SGM.
  • Análise de Dados e Relatórios: Confeccionar relatórios técnicos detalhados de manutenções corretivas, preventivas, calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica. Realizar análises críticas para apresentar ao cliente o status dos equipamentos, sugerindo soluções técnicas e economicamente viáveis para otimizar a gestão do parque tecnológico. Manter o coordenador imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e desafios, buscando soluções e alinhando estratégias em reuniões e contatos diários.
  • Relacionamento com o Cliente e Expansão de Serviço: Atuar como ponto de contato técnico principal com a equipe e gestão do hospital cliente para assuntos relacionados à engenharia clínica. Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações, conforme a necessidade do cliente, com o objetivo de ampliar o escopo de serviços e soluções oferecidas.
  • Gestão de Ativos e Recursos: Zelar pela conservação e organização de todos os equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, solicitando reposição quando necessário. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo, delegadas pelo coordenador de engenharia clínica ou superior imediato.

description:
Software Platform Engineering Manager – Ubuntu for Next‑Gen Silicon

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

With more than 1,200 colleagues in 75 countries, Canonical is a founder‑led, profitable, and constantly growing company that champions global distributed collaboration. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person at interesting locations around the world to align on strategy and execution. This is a globally remote role with open positions in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform‑oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we’re looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation
  • Result‑oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC‑V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross‑compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring‑up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Andi Case

CEO

You will grow a team of engineers, collaborate with other engineering and business teams, and provide periodic updates about successes and areas of improvement.

As an engineering manager you must be technically strong, but your responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage, helping them grow as engineers.

Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.

title: Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel
description:
Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel

Join to apply for the Software Engineering Manager - Ubuntu Linux Kernel role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

Our customers include the world’s leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Software Engineering Managers to lead technical teams in the various aspects of the delivery and ongoing support and maintenance of all Linux kernels provided by the Ubuntu Linux distribution. As the Linux kernel itself is now quite broad, so are the technical domains and challenges involved, ranging from integrating support for bleeding‑edge hardware into the latest Ubuntu kernels, to expanding the range of execution environments available to Ubuntu, to the complexities inherent in applying the latest fixes and updates to all of the >100 Ubuntu Linux kernels under active support during our Stable Release Update cycles.

This role would suit either an experienced manager of high‑performing software development teams, or a very proficient technical lead who is excited to take on a management responsibility. You will need to be passionate about Linux and aspire to be an integral part in its distribution to millions of users worldwide.

The role entails

  • Leading a distributed team of software engineers in your geographic region in distinct aspects of delivery of all Linux kernels for the Ubuntu Linux distribution.
  • Taking ownership of particular aspects of Ubuntu Linux which can include but not be limited to:
    • Working with silicon or cloud partners to implement Linux kernels optimised for their execution environments.
    • Ensuring Ubuntu Linux is able to run on a wide range of diverse hardware platforms.
    • Definition and execution of the stringent quality control standards expected by the Ubuntu user community.
    • Mitigation of the latest security threats and exploits to the Linux kernel.
    • Strong process automation as it pertains to the build, test, and delivery of the Linux kernel.
  • Engagement with other teams at Canonical, the open source community and commercial partners.

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in C, with Python, Golang, or other like languages is also highly regarded.
  • Substantial experience with operating system kernel internals and concepts, Linux would be highly regarded but not essential.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading a team of software engineers.
  • Ability to coordinate between multiple distinct teams of differing technical focus to achieve common goals.
  • Familiarity with version control practices, ideally with git.
  • Prior experience developing with software packaging formats, with direct Ubuntu/Debian/Snap experience being highly regarded.
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent presentation skills.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

Nice-to-have skills

  • Demonstrated experience with kernel patching and debugging.
  • Strong grasp of device drivers, BSPs, and other low‑level system engineering.
  • Solid background in driving CI/CD and process automation initiatives.
  • Prior public involvement with an open source project.

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Seniority level: Mid‑Senior level

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Engineering and Information Technology
